name: list_tts_voices
description: List every text-to-speech voice this box offers, grouped by provider (OpenAI, Gemini Flash and Pro, ElevenLabs premium and cloned voices, local and on-box voices), with each group's availability and the box's default voice. Pass a returned voice id (provider:voice, e.g. elevenlabs:<voice_id>) to text_to_speech.
returns: Voice ids grouped by provider, each group's availability, and the default voice
